intro: The Savor sipper is your perfect daily companion. Made from durable stainless steel with a comfortable, easy-to-hold design, it keeps every sip fresh, safe, and exactly how you like it.

features.title: Made from high-quality stainless steel
features.text: Our sipper is crafted from durable, food-grade stainless steel, ensuring long-lasting use while keeping your drinks fresh and pure.

features.title: A vertical design that fits perfectly in your hand
features.text: Our sleek, easy-to-hold shape makes sipping on the go effortless—whether you're at the gym, commuting, or working at your desk.

features.title: BPA-free and safe for everyday use
features.text: Our design is made with non-toxic, BPA-free materials, so every sip is as safe and refreshing as it should be.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
